title: Company Objective Loom: Dynamic Initiative Rebalancing & Escalation Triggers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and lightweight tooling to continuously reconcile company-level OKRs with active initiatives across ENG/DS/Design/Sales. The goal is a repeatable process that detects misalignment, suggests initiative rebalancing (re-scope/deferral/accelerate), and defines clear escalation triggers for leadership review. This is cross-functional guardrails + a small dashboard prototype for PM/Leadership consumption.
background_and_rationale: We observed drift between stated company objectives and engineer-level initiatives during Q1 retros and the last all-hands: several mid-priority projects consumed runway without contributing to Northstar metrics. The current cadence (quarterly roadmap sync + ad-hoc status emails) is too coarse to catch emerging misalignment. This ticket scopes a playbook and a minimal data surface to make rebalancing decisions timely and auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published to Confluence with decision flow, RACI, and three example scenarios (resource rebalancing, MVP refocus, controlled deferral).

Prototype initiative alignment dashboard (read-only) that maps active initiatives to company OKRs and shows a vulnerability score per initiative. Dashboard is populated by data from Product Tracker + engineering sprint velocity and CS signals.

Escalation triggers defined (quantitative + qualitative) and integrated into weekly leadership digest. Triggers include: initiative OKR-contribution < 40% for 2 consecutive weeks, burn rate > 1.5x planned, and customer-impact flag set by CS/Support.
Playbook reviewed and signed off by Eng Director, Head of Revenue, Head of Design, and VP Product.
Pilot run executed with 6 cross-functional initiatives during one re-prioritization window and retro captured lessons learned.
success_metrics: Reduce scope creep incidents by 30% for initiatives mapped to company OKRs in the pilot cohort.
Time-to-decision for escalation/rebalancing reduced from 21 days to under 7 days for flagged initiatives.
Leadership satisfaction score on alignment process >= 4/5 in post-pilot survey.
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: Discovery interviews with PMs of 12 highest-impact initiatives; capture existing signal sources and gaps.
Week 3: Publish draft playbook + decision flow; demo prototype dashboard with sample data.
Week 4-6: Iterate playbook and dashboard based on stakeholder feedback; lock escalation thresholds and RACI.
Week 7-10: Pilot with 6 initiatives (2 per pillar: Platform, Product, GTM); run weekly digest and one decision window.
Week 11: Retro and finalize playbook; prepare handoff to Operations for ongoing cadence.
dependencies: ENG-48120 (product-tracker export API): needs small schema addition for OKR tags
ENG-48809 (internal dashboard infra): allocate 1 sprint of dashboard time
PM-32401 (initiative taxonomy clean-up): ensures consistent mapping to OKR pillars
CS-2102 (customer-impact flags): operationalize in Support workflow
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: initiative owners game metrics to avoid being flagged. Mitigation: combine quantitative signal with qualitative manager attestation and random spot-checks.
Risk: data latency causes false positives. Mitigation: clearly document data freshness and use smoothing (rolling 14-day windows) for alerts.
Risk: too many triggers -> alert fatigue. Mitigation: tiered severity and aggregated weekly digest; only P1 triggers surface immediately.
budget_and_resources: Request: 0.2 FTE Eng for integration work (2 sprints), 0.5 FTE Analytics for prototype dashboards (4 weeks), 0.3 FTE PM for stakeholder coordination during pilot.
Estimated infra cost for dashboard hosting: <$500/month (hosted on internal BI).
